# M1 Prime Holdings

> M1 Prime Holdings builds business credit from zero and decodes the psychology in music. Home of the FPP Playbook, BeatCypher, and the Syntropy Engine.

## Properties

- [The Syntropy Engine](https://syntropyengine.com): Type in a person, event, or idea and get the psychology and patterns behind it.
- [BeatCypher](https://musicpsychologyhub.com): Decodes the psychology inside a track, lyrics or not. Three free decodes, then $7 one time for unlimited decodes.
- [The FPP Playbook](https://prisontoprime.com): 79 pages on building corporate credit from zero. $47 one time. All sales final.
- [Prime Chess Legacies](https://m1primeholdings.com/chess/): Play White against Gemini in your browser, with a mid-game Coach.
